text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much you train or build your 
body, making your heart stronger too is 
just—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...No, that's just an excuse. That's 
practically admitting that I'm weak...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna train even more, even harder...! 
Don't try to stop me, Trainer...!
choice_data_list:
Let's not rush—let's keep moving forward 
steadily.
Yeah, let's go all the way!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe Trainer is right right now... No, 
I need to cool my head...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Got it, I'll do what you say. So... teach 
me more about how to win...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, no slacking and no compromises...! 
Next time, I'm gonna run a race I won't 
regret!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Still, you're getting just as fired up 
as I am, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, sounds good. That means we're 
both going all out...!
